title: 3.1 Greetings and Names
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Recognize and use three greetings plus the fixed name question and answer.
grammar_function: My and your are learned only inside the fixed name chunks; possessive substitution waits for 3.10.
prerequisite: Unit 1 identity questions and Unit 2 text/audio choice routines.
speaking_outcome: Repeat a greeting, ask What is your name?, answer with a name, and close with Goodbye.
